input.command:
cd /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip && git add \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/wrangler.toml \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/env.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/app.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/route-registry.ts && \
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(deploy-cloudflare): wire Workers Assets binding and fix authRoutes prefix

- Replace pages_build_output_dir (Pages-only) with [assets] binding in wrangler.toml.
  Uses not_found_handling = "single-page-application" so CF serves index.html for
  unknown paths (needed for client-side routing). The ASSETS Fetcher binding is
  forwarded in the Hono SPA fallback instead of a hardcoded HTML stub.

- Add ASSETS: Fetcher to Env interface so the SPA fallback can call env.ASSETS.fetch().

- Fix authRoutes prefix: server mounts authRoutes at /api/auth but route-registry
  was passing /api, causing /api/auth/get-session to return 501.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Commit the static assets and auth fix
